**Record struct** in the `Latiprimere` namespace, from the [Latiprimere.Abstractions](/docs/reference/#latiprimereabstractions) package.

```csharp
public readonly record struct PageRange
```

A run of pages to print, counted from 1, both ends included, as [PrintOptions.PageRanges](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/#pageranges) takes them. One page is a range whose first and last are the same: `new PageRange(3, 3)`.

## Constructors

```csharp
public PageRange(int first, int last)
```

Initialises a new instance of the [PageRange](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/pagerange/) struct.

**Parameters**

- `first`: The first page, from 1.
- `last`: The last page, at least `first`.

**Exceptions**

- [ArgumentOutOfRangeException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentoutofrangeexception): `first` is less than 1, or `last` is less than `first`.
